# Mixing Light

> > Professional color grading training and education platform specializing in DaVinci Resolve, Baselight, and ACES workflows for colorists and post-production professionals.

Mixing Light offers comprehensive tutorials, courses, and industry insights from expert colorists including Joey D'Anna, Patrick Inhofer, and Juan Ignacio Cabrera. The platform covers technical workflows, creative techniques, and business strategies for colorists working in film, television, and commercial production.

## Key Topics

- DaVinci Resolve
- Color Grading Workflows
- ACES (Academy Color Encoding System)
- ACEScct
- Baselight
- Color Management
- HDR Grading
- Resolve Color Management (RCM)
- Node-Based Grading
- Colorist Career Development
- Post-Production
- Look Development
- Cinematographer-Colorist Collaboration
- Professional Networking
- Demo Reel Creation

## Getting Started & Core Training

- [Level Up Your Digital Color Grading & Post Production Skills](https://mixinglight.com/activate): Main membership activation page for DaVinci Resolve training library
- [Learn DaVinci Resolve - A Beginner Quickstart](https://mixinglight.com/training/davinci-resolve-fundamentals-a-quickstart): Beginner fundamentals course for DaVinci Resolve by Patrick Inhofer

## Advanced Color Grading Techniques

- [Look Development: Part 1](https://mixinglight.com/color-grading-tutorials/look-development-part-1-laying-the-foundation): Foundation tutorial on color management and ACES for look development
- [Binary Logic In The Node Tree: Creating Procedural Node Structures](https://mixinglight.com/color-grading-tutorials/binary-logic-in-the-node-tree-creating-procedural-node-structures): Joey D'Anna tutorial on building logic gates in DaVinci Resolve nodes
- [The 10-Minute Grade: Shot Balancing](https://mixinglight.com/color-grading-tutorials/the-10-minute-grade-shot-balancing): Cullen Kelly demonstrates quick shot balancing techniques in Resolve
- [HDR Palette 101 - Resolve Color Management 2.0 + Contrast Controls](https://mixinglight.com/color-grading-tutorials/hdr-palette-101-contrast-resolve-color-management-2): Part 3: HDR Palette contrast controls with RCM 2.0 in DaVinci Resolve
- [DaVinci Resolve 17.4.5 - Custom YRGB Output Color Spaces](https://mixinglight.com/color-grading-tutorials/davinci-resolve-17_4_5-custom-yrgb-output-color-spaces): Joey D'Anna explains custom output color spaces in YRGB projects

## Baselight Workflows

- [Baselight Start to Finish - Project Creation & Conform](https://mixinglight.com/color-grading-tutorials/baselight-start-to-finish-project-creation-conform): Complete Baselight workflow from project setup to conform and grading
- [How To Organize Media Using the 'Shots View' In Baselight Student](https://mixinglight.com/color-grading-tutorials/how-to-organize-media-using-the-shots-view-in-baselight-student): Baselight tutorial on media organization and group grading workflows

## Industry Insights & Interviews

- [Colorist Podcast Episode 014: Juan Ignacio Cabrera, CSI](https://mixinglight.com/color-grading-tutorials/colorist-podcast-014-juan-ignacio-cabrera): Podcast interview with Juan Ignacio Cabrera on HDR, ACES, and VFX work
- [Building A Dynamic Demo Reel With Dávid Láposi - Mailbag LIVE!](https://mixinglight.com/color-grading-tutorials/mailbag-live-building-a-dynamic-demo-reel-with-david-laposi): Live session with Dávid Láposi on creating story-based demo reels
- [Photochemical Color Timing + Cinematographers and Colorists](https://mixinglight.com/color-grading-tutorials/photochemical-colortiming-the-role-of-the-cinematographer-in-a-grade): Mailbag Q&A on photochemical timing and DP-colorist collaboration

## Career & Business Development

- [How To Network Professionally (without leaving the house)](https://mixinglight.com/color-grading-tutorials/effective-professional-networking-without-leaving-the-house): Katie Hinsen on online networking and personal branding for introverts
- [Using Milestone Payments to Get Paid More Reliably](https://mixinglight.com/color-grading-tutorials/getting-paid-more-reliably-as-a-creative-professional-with-milestone-payments): Business advice on implementing milestone payments for freelancers
- [Dealing With Helicopter Clients](https://mixinglight.com/color-grading-tutorials/dealing-helicopter-clients): Client management strategies for handling micromanaging clients
